question: What completes the prescribed worship arrangement including the lords of the directions and their weapons?
premises: The lords of the directions are to be worshipped.
The thunderbolt and other weapons are also included.
This arrangement is declared as the worship.
inference: The worship is complete when the directional lords and their weapons are included as described.
plain_english: Also worship the lords of the directions and the thunderbolt and other weapons; thus the worship is declared.
